name: ordito-add-block
description: Insert a NEW block into an existing Ordito IR document. name: ordito-create-page
description: Create a NEW Ordito IR document (a new docs page) in the IR store. Use this when the user has agreed to add a brand-new page to the docs (not edit an existing one) — e.g. "新しいページを作る" / "○○のガイドを追加". Writes one new IR document by logical id, sets meta.title and meta.updated_at, leaves generated_at null, and can optionally place the page into the collection nav in the same call. Refuses if the id already exists or is the reserved "index". Does NOT regenerate any HTML (generation is the separate ordito-generate step) and does NOT ask for confirmation itself; the calling agent owns that decision.

name: ordito-delete-page
description: Delete a whole Ordito IR document (page) from the store. Use this when the user has agreed to remove an entire page from the docs. Deletes the IR file and, by default, also removes the page's entry from the collection nav (pruning now-empty groups). Already-generated out/<id>.html is NOT deleted (it just stops being regenerated) — the skill notes this. Does NOT regenerate HTML (ordito-generate is separate) and does NOT ask for confirmation itself; the calling agent owns that decision.

name: ordito-detect-stale
description: List Ordito IR documents whose content has changed since their last HTML generation (updated_at is newer than generated_at, or never generated). Read-only; touches nothing. Use this to gather material for asking the user "未反映が N 件あります。反映（再生成）しますか？" before deciding whether to run ordito-generate. Returns a JSON list of stale pages with their timestamps. Does not generate, does not confirm — the calling agent presents the result and asks.

name: ordito-edit-collection
description: Edit the Ordito collection (the site nav / sitemap) — add, move, remove, relabel, or reorder nav entries and groups. Use this when the user wants to change how pages are organized in the navigation: put a page under a group, reorder items, rename a nav label, create a group, or drop a page from the nav. Operates ONLY on the collection (nav items/order/groups, §3.5); it does not touch page content (IR). Validates the collection after editing and does NOT regenerate HTML (ordito-generate is separate). Does NOT ask for confirmation; the calling agent owns that.

name: ordito-generate
description: Explicitly (re)generate Ordito HTML pages from IR + template contract + collection, and stamp meta.generated_at. This is the heavy, explicit "反映（再生成）" step — run it ONLY after the user has agreed to reflect changes (e.g. "反映しますか？" → yes). It can regenerate everything, only specific page ids, or only stale pages (only:"stale"). It MUST NOT be run as a side effect of updating IR — updating (ordito-update-block) never triggers generation (spec §5.4). The calling agent owns the confirmation; this skill just generates and returns a report.

name: ordito-init
description: Scaffold Ordito into a repository — create ordito.config.json, the docs IR directory, a starter page, a collection (nav), and a GitHub Pages deploy workflow (.github/workflows/docs.yml). Idempotent: existing files are left untouched unless force:true. Does NOT generate HTML (run ordito-generate after) and does NOT ask for confirmation; the calling agent owns that.

name: ordito-move-block
description: Reorder or re-parent an existing block within an Ordito IR document (write to the IR store). Use this when the user wants to change the ORDER of content on a page, or move a block into/out of a tab — without changing the block's content. Moves exactly one existing block by id to a new position (at/after/before a sibling, or inside a tab), validates the result, and bumps meta.updated_at. Does NOT regenerate HTML (ordito-generate is separate) and does NOT ask for confirmation; the calling agent owns that.

name: ordito-remove-block
description: Delete one block from an existing Ordito IR document (write to the IR store). Use this when the user has agreed to remove a specific piece of content from a page — a now-obsolete note, paragraph, code sample, etc. Removes exactly one block by id (including blocks nested inside tabs), validates the remaining document, and bumps meta.updated_at. Does NOT regenerate HTML (ordito-generate is the separate step) and does NOT ask for confirmation itself; the calling agent owns that decision.

name: ordito-update-block
description: Apply a block-level diff update to an Ordito IR document (write to the IR store). Use this AFTER the user has agreed that a specific piece of knowledge/content should be recorded into the docs — e.g. "記載しておきますか？" → yes. Updates exactly one block (by block id, including blocks nested inside tabs) and bumps meta.updated_at. It does NOT regenerate any HTML (generation is a separate, explicit step — see ordito-generate) and it does NOT ask for confirmation itself; the calling agent owns that decision. Idempotent: re-applying an identical patch is a no-op.

Use ao orquestrar >5 arquivos independentes, montar workflow/fan-out, ou quando um run morre no meio. Gatilhos: "subagents", "fan-out", "workflow", "paralelo em N arquivos", "rate limit 429/529".

name: orquestracao
description: Carta do Orquestrador do Janus — como a sessão principal dirige uma versão. Modelos por camada (orquestrador pensa/julga; subagentes Sonnet executam), delegação autocontida com "Skills a ler", paralelização por arquivos disjuntos (subagentes são editores puros; git/build/banco/servidor serializados no orquestrador), protocolo de revisão (revisor, revisor-db, verificador-visual), gates escalonados e o piloto do advisor (quem consulta, quando, e como medir). Use ao iniciar a sessão de uma versão (o /nova-versao a carrega), ao despachar subagentes, ao planejar paralelização de missões ou ao deci…

name: orquestracao-agentes
description: Orquestra agentes Cursor em três camadas: núcleo generalista (design, testes, código limpo, gates, revisão), transversais (segurança, contrato de API, memória) e packs de domínio opcionais. Use ao iniciar feature/bug, escolher agente, montar o time, orquestração, ou estrutura de agentes. Não substitui as skills especializadas — só escolhe e encadeia.

name: orquestracao-claude-code
description: Roteamento multimodelo dentro do Claude Code/Cowork: quando delegar a subagentes Haiku/Sonnet/Opus, como separar executor e revisor, e quando parar para aprovação humana. Usar ao planejar tarefas com mais de uma etapa ou ao delegar.

name: orquestracao-contrato
description: Protocolo do agente orquestrador — transforma o enunciado em esquema D1 + contrato de API, divide o trabalho entre agentes especialistas com escopos de arquivo disjuntos, integra os resultados e só declara pronto depois do agente de teste. Use no início do projeto e a cada rodada de integração.

name: orquestracao-de-sessoes
description: Coordena várias sessões do Claude Code no terminal, cada uma numa pasta do projeto (ex.: uma por projeto de uma solution C#: Api, Infra...), com cargos e regras definidos pelo usuário num arquivo SESSAO.md por pasta, canais inbox/outbox e mensagens entre sessões. Use ao montar um time de sessões, despachar ou aceitar tarefas entre elas, ou quando o usuário falar em "orquestrador", "SESSAO.md", "despachar task", "inbox", "outbox", "chamar a sessão do <cargo>".

name: orquestracao-hermes
description: Roteamento multimodelo para automações no Hermes: modelo local (Ollama/MLX) para volume, API para julgamento, fila de exceções para humano, e quando entregar a tarefa ao Claude Code. Usar ao desenhar ou ajustar fluxos e agentes do Hermes.

name: orquestracao-kanban-humano-agente
description: Orquestrar projetos com Kanban humano + agentes de IA.

name: orquestracao-multi-branch
description: Use quando o pedido for despachar várias issues do backlog em paralelo como "agent master" — várias threads de trabalho, cada uma em worktree própria, indo até PR aberto sem merge. Cobre seleção de issue sem colisão de diff, cap de paralelismo, encadeamento de skills auxiliares por thread, e o checkpoint de parada. NÃO use pra implementar uma única issue (fluxo normal de branch) nem pra revisar PR pronto (isso é auditoria-de-pr).

name: orquestracao-multimodelo
description: Use when rotear ou delegar tarefa entre modelos.

name: orquestracao-orca
description: Roteamento multimodelo no Orca ADE: qual CLI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok) recebe cada tarefa, quando fazer fan-out paralelo em worktrees, revisão cruzada por agente diferente e merge só com aprovação humana. Usar ao abrir tarefas no Orca.

name: orquestracao-refinamento-multi-modelo
description: Orquestração de refinamento de planos de implementação usando múltiplos modelos (Claude Opus para profundidade, Gemini 3.1 Pro para visão arquitetural). Cobre decomposição em seções, execução paralela via background processes, e compilação dos resultados.

name: orquestracao-worktree
description: Use when orquestrar worktree no Orca.

name: orquestracao1
description: Orquestração MEGABRAIN V6 primária: execução local limitada entre Claude e Codex, com plano revisado antes da produção, rota explícita, evidências e entrega humana. Use para trabalho multiagente novo; não agenda tarefas nem aplica mudanças por conta própria.

name: orquestracao2
description: Compatibilidade MEGABRAIN V5 para retomar ou reproduzir fluxos históricos de loop e swarm entre Claude, Codex e Spark. Use somente por pedido explícito ou execução existente; novos trabalhos usam /orquestracao1 V6.

name: orquestracao_hermes
description: Orquestração Híbrida (IA Online Antigravity + IA Local Ollama) com Ciclo de Aprendizado Contínuo e fila de tarefas.

name: orquestrador
description: Conduz uma entrega full stack de ponta a ponta: planeja as camadas (arquitetura, banco, backend, frontend, infra, docs), delega a subagents baratos o que não exige o modelo principal e valida cada camada antes de avançar. Use quando: criar uma aplicação completa, implementar uma feature que atravessa mais de uma camada, ou coordenar várias frentes de trabalho no mesmo projeto.

name: orquestrador
description: Usa em TODO trabalho com 2 ou mais partes independentes, ANTES de comecar a fazer sozinho - feature em varios arquivos, tela nova mais servidor, auditoria ou revisao ampla, migracao, bug que cruza componentes, lote de tarefas parecidas, pesquisa com varias fontes - e pra revisar codigo nao trivial que voce mesmo escreveu antes de subir. Tambem quando o usuario falar "orquestra", "orquestrar", "use a skill orquestrar", "usa os operarios", "joga pros agentes", "modo chefe", "modo god", "engenheiro", "mestre de obras", "manda o haiku/sonnet fazer", "divide o trabalho", "faz em paralelo", "como o…

name: orquestrador
description: Use no projeto coordenador ao distribuir e acompanhar planejamento, implementação e revisão de stories de outros projetos, incluindo dependências, panes Herdr, bloqueios e conclusão das rodadas.

name: orquestrador
description: Use when the user sends /orquestrador with a topic of the project map (mapa HTML), a range of task ids (for example A10 to A20) or a list of ids to run; the session becomes the orchestrator that runs those tasks with subagents until they are done.

name: orquestrador
description: Use quando o usuário quer conduzir a esteira de release notes de ponta a ponta — coordenar coletor → validador → montador → notificador e acionar o deploy via sync-repos-from-master, com segurança por ação e aprovação humana. Gatilhos: "Optimus Prime", "Optimus Prime iniciar", "Optimus Prime verificar", "Optimus Prime executar", "Optimus Prime verificar todos os boards", "Optimus Prime iniciar todos os boards", "iniciar deploy", "montar e preparar a release", "rodar a esteira". Contexto atual: MCPs Atlassian + Notion e comandos `make` do sync-repos-from-master; papel agnóstico.

name: orquestrador
description: Coordenar workers Codex/Claude em terminais do Orca no miupy-notes sem inflar o contexto do coordenador (escolha de agente e esforço, briefs, acompanhamento, integração, scripts de estado e Graphify).

name: orquestrador
description: Interprets the instruction, keeps spec.yaml, delegates to the other agents and runs the human control points.

name: orquestrador
description: Aciona o Orquestrador Autonomo para conduzir a esteira adaptativa de 5 Macro-Etapas (com triagem previa de impacto para acionar apenas as etapas e agentes necessarios) ou despachar Agentes Auxiliares sob demanda.

name: orquestrador
description: Orquestrador (Gatilhos: orquestrar, dividir tarefa, subtarefa, coordenar agentes, maestro)

name: orquestrador
description: Sessão principal que divide a demanda em frentes e controla sessões filhas (brief, bastão por contexto, PR, merge com CI verde, arquivamento). Só pelo /orquestrador.

name: orquestrador
description: Ponto de entrada único do segundo cérebro de Gabriel Rabelo. Use quando não souber qual skill ativar, quando o pedido envolver múltiplas áreas, ou quando quiser que o sistema decida o melhor caminho. Analisa o contexto e roteia para a skill certa (ou combina várias).

name: orquestrador
description: Orquestrar trabalho com várias frentes: dividir por arquivos, escolher executores e revisores, acompanhar entregas e conferir resultados. Use quando o usuário pedir orquestração ou quando dividir entre agentes trouxer ganho real. Inclui reservas de modelos e fontes, sem pular revisão por falta de cota; produto e ações externas não autorizadas ficam com o usuário.

name: orquestrador
description: Papel de orquestrador deste projeto e o seu ciclo de autoaperfeiçoamento. Use ao assumir a orquestração (sessão nova, retomada), ao abrir ou fechar uma etapa, ao fazer merge e sempre que algo sair do previsto (bloqueante do revisor, CI vermelha repetida, correção do dono, incidente de ambiente). A skill é viva: edita a si mesma por PR.

name: Orquestrador Jurídico
description: This skill should be used when the user sends ANY message in a legal/juridical context, mentions law firm work, asks about legal tasks without specifying a skill, says 'ajuda jurídica', 'preciso de ajuda', 'sou advogado', 'escritório de advocacia', or sends a message that could map to any of the available legal skills. This orchestrator auto-detects the demand, runs a structured intake to collect all necessary information one question at a time, then activates the correct specialized skill.

name: orquestrador-autonomo
description: Montar e operar um orquestrador autônomo de desenvolvimento num repositório, novo ou existente. Fase 0 arquiteta junto com o dono (BMAD enxuto + Superpowers) e gera o roadmap; Fase 1 monta a fundação (gates que medem); Fase 2 roda em loop autoalimentado (planejador escreve tickets, executor implementa em worktree via Claude Code headless, gates mecânicos + juiz-LLM validam, sentinela transforma bugs em tickets); Fase 3 promove para produção com merge humano. Use esta skill sempre que o usuário quiser: criar/replicar um orquestrador, "fábrica de tickets", loop autônomo, fila que se alimenta so…

name: orquestrador-conteudo
description: Orquestra a geração de um PACK de conteúdos (vários formatos de uma vez) para um produto da Lilian. Use APENAS para pedidos de pacote: "gera os conteúdos da semana/quinzena", "monta o pack", "monta o calendário", "não sei o que postar". Para UMA peça específica, use a skill de formato (conteudo-linkedin, conteudo-reel, conteudo-legenda, criador-carrossel) — não esta. Segue o intake obrigatório (produto → objetivo → categoria + checklist) e chama as skills de formato.

name: orquestrador-de-agentes
description: Método para conduzir um projeto de software como orquestrador de agentes (codificadores, revisores, auditores, testadores e apoio), com o dono como gestor. Use ao assumir a orquestração, distribuir trabalho, decidir modelo e paralelismo, conduzir branch → PR → CI → revisão → merge e registrar regras e aprendizados. A skill `orquestrador` do projeto complementa esta.

name: orquestrador-de-ias
description: Divide uma tarefa grande ou com varias partes entre varias IAs ao mesmo tempo e junta o resultado. Use para pesquisas com varios angulos, planos, comparacoes, textos longos ou quando a pessoa pedir "usa varias IAs" / "orquestra".

name: orquestrador-empresa
description: Orquestrador da empresa de agentes (Sala de Comando do gêmeo). Recebe uma tarefa, identifica a área certa e a encaminha ao(s) agente(s) de área via Task, consolidando o resultado. Use quando a tarefa não for obviamente de uma única área, ou quando quiser delegar sem escolher o agente manualmente, ou para tarefas multi-área (ex.: um lançamento).

name: orquestrador-estudos-datasus
description: Atua como coautor rigoroso (Analista + Revisor metodológico) em pesquisas de base ecológica utilizando o Data SUS e R. Make sure to use this skill WHENEVER the user mentions DataSUS, epidemiologia, estudos ecológicos, RMarkdown, microdatasus, or asks to initiate/write a research study with public Brazilian health data.

name: orquestrador-fable
description: Orquestrador multiagente agnóstico de runtime: analisa a forma do pedido, planeja e delega a executores escolhidos por capacidade, effort e slots descobertos na sessão; depois roda o Comitê de Lentes e o testador-real, repetindo planejar, executar e avaliar até a nota alvo. Acione com "orquestra essa tarefa", "usa o orquestrador", "divide o trabalho entre os modelos", "libera os subagentes", "roda o ciclo completo até a nota de corte", "faz com o comitê avaliando", "quero isso com qualidade máxima". NÃO acione para etapa isolada (use a skill da etapa) nem para sequência determinística de gera…

name: orquestrador-fluxo-ia
description: Orquestra tarefas de desenvolvimento no fluxo Intranet/ORCA depois do planejamento do Tech Lead, acionando automaticamente planejamento operacional, implementação, revisão, revalidação, QA, integração e publicação no ClickUp. Use ao continuar uma tarefa desse fluxo; preserva os checkpoints humanos de ClickUp, Tech Lead, criação das worktrees, correções de code review e push/PR.

name: orquestrador-maestro
description: Aplica o contrato compartilhado do Orquestrador Maestro ao trabalho de código e projeto.

name: orquestrador-master
description: Organiza, audita, planeja e melhora projetos de software, pesquisa, documentos, design ou organização com evidências e revisão proporcional. Use para compreender um projeto, priorizar melhorias ou executar uma mudança completa autorizada, adaptando o procedimento às ferramentas e ao LLM disponíveis.

name: orquestrador-orca
description: Claude (modelo da cadeia O — hoje Fable 5.2) como orquestrador no Orca ADE. Divide a tarefa, planeja, usa Jev/Laya para decisões fechadas sem gastar LLM, dispara workers Claude e Grok em janelas/worktrees do projeto (GPT/Codex só quando realmente necessário), escolhe o modelo pela skill roteamento-modelos, revisa por família diferente e para no gate humano. Usar ao abrir qualquer tarefa no Orca, ao "orquestrar", "rodar os tickets", "delegar para o Codex/Grok" ou quando a sessão principal estiver gastando token em trabalho de volume.

name: orquestrador-subagentes
description: Orquestra subagentes em paralelo (tarefas independentes) ou sequencial (tarefas interdependentes). Use quando dividir trabalho complexo, coordenar múltiplos agentes, delegar domínios distintos, ou decidir entre execução paralela vs encadeada.

name: orquestrador-tarefas
description: Ponto de entrada e roteador do fluxo de desenvolvimento no ADC framework. Use SEMPRE que o usuário registrar uma nova demanda e quiser transformá-la em tarefas executáveis — seja uma nova funcionalidade, conformidade, correção, evolução ou qualquer pedido que resulte em execução por um assistente especializado. Acione para: "processa essa demanda", "transforma em tarefa", "planeja essa conformidade", "o que precisa ser feito para X", "prepara para execução", "roteia essa demanda". Este assistente analisa a demanda, aciona os assistentes corretos na sequência certa e garante que tudo esteja pr…

name: orquestrador-task
description: Conduz um card (task) do board de ponta a ponta, de forma autônoma: intake, spec, plano, testes primeiro (RED), implementação, gate determinístico, revisão paralela por especialistas, triagem de findings, correção em loop com limite de rodadas de code review, verificação independente e entrega do branch com pacote de provas. Use quando o usuário rodar /workflow-ia:task, pedir para executar/pegar/fazer um card ou task (ex.: VST-123, URL do Notion/Linear/GitHub, texto de card) ou quando houver task ativa em .workflow-ia/runtime/active-task; também conduz o ajuste pós-entrega de uma task CONCLUI…

name: orquestradora
description: Papel de orquestradora do projeto — recebe os pedidos do operador, quebra em itens, abre uma sessão dona por item, conversa com elas, repassa as perguntas e indica a hora do release. Use quando o operador disser "você é a orquestradora", "orquestra isso", "abre uma sessão para cada", ou ao assumir uma sessão marcada com o papel orquestradora.

name: orquestramd
description: Coordena tarefas com dependências e capacidades disponíveis, em execução individual ou com agentes.

name: orquestrando-claude-codex-grok
description: Use when work would benefit from a second AI engine on this machine — adversarial review of a diff or security fix, a bulk read-only codebase survey, a factual matrix that needs file:line evidence, or handing mechanical multi-file work to Grok or a small fix to Codex. Covers the official Codex plugin (/codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review, /codex:rescue) and the grok and codex CLIs. Also when the user says orquestrar, delegar, segunda opinião, revisão adversarial, grok, codex, or "effort high".

name: orquestrando-sessoes
description: Guia como dividir trabalho entre sessões de agente — sessão nova ou sub-agente, leitura independente, uma leitura longa em partes e várias sessões na mesma pasta. Usar ao planejar trabalho em fases, abrir a fase seguinte e escolher o modelo da filha, pedir uma auditoria ou conferir o achado de outra sessão, quando a orquestradora vive dias ou várias sessões mexem no mesmo repositório. Não usar para handoff ou compactar (é a passando-o-trabalho), para o conteúdo das regras (é a escrevendo-regras-de-agente) nem para o git do dia a dia (é a git-e-commits).

name: orquestrar

Use quando o usuário pedir "orquestra isso", "delega pros workers", "usa os workers" ou quando a tarefa for grande e repetitiva, por exemplo mexer em muitos arquivos, renomear em massa, migrar testes ou aplicar o mesmo padrão em vários lugares. Não use para tarefas pequenas ou que dependem de julgamento.

name: orquestrar
description: Assume o papel de ORQUESTRADOR do projeto: lê SPEC.md, CLAUDE.md e PLAN.md e executa o plano fase por fase, delegando cada task ao sub-agent correto com contexto isolado, respeitando dependências e gates. Use sempre que o usuário pedir para "orquestrar", "executar o plano", "rodar o PLAN.md", "tocar o projeto" ou executar uma sprint/fase inteira.

name: orquestrar
description: Atalho alternativo para /orquestrador. Aciona o Orquestrador Autonomo para conduzir a esteira adaptativa de 5 Macro-Etapas (com triagem previa de impacto para acionar apenas as etapas e agentes necessarios) ou despachar Agentes Auxiliares sob demanda.

name: orquestrar
description: Orquestra o desenvolvimento do Apolo com o Claude Code como mestre e o Codex CLI e o Antigravity CLI (agy) como workers em worktrees isoladas. Use quando o usuário pedir para "orquestrar", "delegar para o Codex/Antigravity", "usar os workers" ou dividir uma entrega do Apolo entre agentes.

name: orquestrar
description: Divide uma tarefa entre modelos de custo diferente: o modelo principal planeja e integra; agentes baratos localizam (batedor, Haiku), implementam passos definidos (operario, Sonnet) e revisam (revisor, Sonnet). name: orquestrar

Use quando o usuario pedir /orquestrar, "modo equipe", "delega pro time", ou uma tarefa de desenvolvimento com varias partes.

name: orquestrar
description: Organiza frentes de trabalho quando o usuário pede orquestração, roadmap, próximos prompts, retomada de vários chats ou um painel de dependências. Confere fontes e estados, separa preparação de envio e conclusão, identifica o próximo passo de cada frente e mantém um HTML offline com prompts copiáveis. Não é gatilho para iniciar execução, delegação ou automações.

name: orquestrar
description: Orquestrador geral: recebe um pedido ou tarefa para a IA, cria a tarefa no Kanban da empresa, divide em subtarefas, delega cada uma ao agente especialista certo (estrategista, roteirista, designer, editor-de-video, sound-designer, pesquisador, revisor), acompanha, passa pela revisão e devolve ao Oliver o que precisa de aval. Use quando o usuário disser 'delega', 'coloca no quadro', 'rode as tarefas', 'roda o quadro', 'tarefas da IA', 'continua as tarefas', 'Rodar IA', 'aprovado' (para retomar uma tarefa em revisão), ou pedir uma entrega que envolva mais de um especialista (ex.: 'faz um vídeo…

name: orquestrar
description: Distribui um plano de execução entre agentes no Orca, escolhendo agente, modelo e effort por task. Use quando houver um plano definido a ser executado por múltiplos agentes em paralelo, ou quando o usuário pedir para orquestrar, distribuir ou paralelizar trabalho já planejado.

name: orquestrar
description: Método para levar qualquer tarefa com IA do pedido vago a um artefato verificado (documento, planilha, slides, pesquisa, código, projeto). Entende o que a pessoa quer, testa o ambiente, escolhe a menor forma de trabalho que resolve, verifica antes de entregar e pede aprovação para ações irreversíveis. Use quando a tarefa tiver mais de um passo, durar mais de uma conversa, produzir um documento ou exigir pesquisa, análise ou decisões. Não use para perguntas simples. EN: method to take any AI task from a vague request to a verified deliverable; use for multi-step work, not quick questions.

name: orquestrar
description: Orquestra um objetivo usando IAs executoras externas (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, xAI) via GitHub Actions — decompõe em tarefas, delega, valida os resultados e integra só o que for aprovado. Use quando o usuário pedir para orquestrar trabalho entre várias IAs, dividir um objetivo entre modelos, ou "usar outras IAs" para produzir algo maior que uma tarefa única.

name: orquestrar
description: Use no início de qualquer tarefa com mais de um passo (site, planilha, design, marketing, código, documento, pesquisa). Entende o pedido, confere as skills instaladas e os modelos cadastrados pelo usuário, escolhe a melhor opção ou combina várias, executa, revisa com checklist e entrega pronto.

name: orquestrar-agentes
description: Simula handoff entre múltiplos agentes (Clara→Marcos→Camila, Sofia→Clara, Luna→Clara, etc.) durante um diálogo de teste e valida se o roteamento segue as regras de AGENTS.md.

name: orquestrar-AREA

name: ory-suite

Use when implementing user authentication, passkeys/MFA, OAuth 2.0/OIDC provider flows, Google Zanzibar ReBAC authorization, Zero-Trust Identity & Access Proxies (IAP), session verification, or building secure cloud-native architectures with @ory/client and ory-client.

name: ory-webhooks

name: Orya Security Review
description: Security audit skill for the QA / Security Agent. Performs zone classification, secrets scanning, auth/RLS review, dependency vetting, and escalation for (R-NO-SECRETS) changes that touch sensitive boundaries in the Orya HQ codebase.

name: Orya UI Verification
description: UI testing and verification skill for the UI Verification Agent. Covers localhost visual inspection, responsive testing, accessibility checks, screenshot capture, and visual regression reporting. Green zone only. (R-ZONE-GREEN)

name: oryh-access-admin
description: Use when an administrator's agent changes who can do what in oryh — grant a capability ("also allow Xie Ting to place purchase orders"), shape roles, invite or disable people, reissue a bundle or credential. Requires users.manage. Never approves or files documents; never grants more than it holds.

name: oryh-approve
description: Use when an approver's agent records ONE approval decision on any oryh document — approve/reject/return a timesheet, expense, purchase request, quotation, order, payment or invoice ("approve this expense claim", "return it for recalculation"). Reviews what that type demands first. Never changes status or routes; that is the flow agent's.

name: oryh-billing-account
description: Use for a party's standing balance in oryh — customer deposit, credit limit, member points/stored value (deposit, draw against credit, grant or redeem points, "what is my points balance"). One account is one balance in one unit. Not for invoicing (oryh-receivables) or paying suppliers (oryh-payables); never converts points to money.

name: oryh-budget
description: Use to plan and follow a workspace's budget in oryh — set the year's plan (a marketing pot, labour cost, a sales target), change it with a reason, read where it stands — building the plan, posting changes with their reasons, reading planned against requested, committed, actual, paid and the sales gap. Requires budget.manage (reading needs budget.read_all; labour actuals also payroll.read).

name: oryh-business-object
description: Use to record, update, query or relate ANY tenant-defined object in oryh (warranty cards, daily reports, service requests…) by reading its object-type definition and business rules at use time. One skill for every custom type. Facts only; routing and approval belong to the flow and approve skills.

name: oryh-business-object-summary
description: Use when a principal wants a summary over business objects of one type — this week's daily reports, who has not filed one. Reads business_objects, optionally scoped by a payload field, and reports in prose. Read-only; never writes or advances a record.

name: oryh-business-rules
description: Use to write, publish, amend, re-scope or repeal any of the workspace's own rules — a company policy (employee handbook, expense policy, compensation policy) or an external standard (social-insurance contribution base, minimum wage), who approves what (an approval flow), what a document must carry when filed (a data rule), what happens elsewhere when it reaches a state (a linkage) — and to split a pre-2026-10 workflow definition into its kinds. Also when an agent needs a figure a policy sets, with its version and publisher. Not for one person's pay (oryh-payroll) or for writing a skill (oryh-…

name: oryh-campaign
description: Use when marketing runs a campaign in oryh — create a trade-fair campaign/online event/email campaign, record contacts reached, review campaign lead and opportunity attribution — creating, advancing and reading campaigns and their members. Requires campaign.manage. Attribution on leads and deals is the sales desk's ($oryh-crm).

name: oryh-channel-order-import
description: Use when a seller's agent lands a file of e-commerce platform orders (Tmall/JD.com/Douyin/Amazon exports — "e-commerce order import", "import this batch of platform orders", "today's Tmall orders") in oryh as DRAFTS — dedup by the platform's number, translate every line through the product map, propose the likeliest catalog product for the rest, have the person confirm every proposal in one message, then create the drafts and link the numbers. Requires order.submit_own. Matching rules are oryh-product-matching's calibration; one listing to sort out by hand is oryh-product-matching; an order f…

name: oryh-connect
description: Use to connect a person's agent to a company's oryh — first run on a new machine ("connect oryh", "sign in oryh"), adding a second employer, or after any oryh skill hits 401. Opens the sign-in page, then installs that company's bundle with a fresh device key. The only oryh skill that works before login.

name: oryh-contracts
description: Use to file or consult contracts in oryh — record a signed contract ("record this manufacturing contract"), answer from its clauses ("what is the payment schedule?", "how much is the deposit?"), record supplements and renewals, link the orders, invoices and payments that execute it. Requires contract.manage, scoped :purchase or :sales.

name: oryh-crm
description: Use when a salesperson's agent works their own pipeline in oryh — capture leads ("captured a contact at the trade fair, record it"), advance them, convert a qualified lead into a customer and opportunity, close won or lost. No approvals; quoting and ordering hand off to oryh-quotation-submit and oryh-order-submit. Requires crm.own.

name: oryh-data-migration
description: Use when a company moves HISTORICAL data into oryh in bulk — historical quotations and sales orders from a retired system, a workbook with thousands of rows, documents that already ended. Master data first, dry run, chunked resumable imports, a report of rows whose customer or product is gone. Not for today's documents (submit skills).

name: oryh-expense-submit
description: Use when a person's agent files, updates, queries or submits their OWN expense claim in oryh — read receipts and invoices, confirm the fields, upload evidence, check duplicates, submit, fix a returned claim. Submitter's facts only; routing and approval belong to other roles.

name: oryh-help
description: Use when someone asks a question ABOUT oryh rather than for work — "can oryh…", "what does this permission mean", "why was I refused with 403", "which skill handles…". Answers from the shipped manual, capability map and FAQ in its references; touches the API only for a live fact. Needs no capability.

name: oryh-inventory
description: Use when a warehouse keeper's agent keeps the stock ledger true in oryh — record storage positions, import stock counts, stock reservation/release, and the stock documents that move goods for reasons no order carries (write-off, transfer, loan/return, production receipt, miscellaneous receipt). Every ledger row is written by a business act; there is no direct movement write. Requires inventory.manage (which includes shipment.manage — parcels are oryh-shipping). Never creates products (oryh-master-data) or places POs (oryh-purchase-order).

name: oryh-leave-submit
description: Use when a person's agent checks their own leave balance or files, amends, withdraws or submits their OWN leave in oryh — "how much annual leave do I have", "request one day off next Wednesday", "request a half-day off in the morning". Computes the balance from the published leave policy. Requester's facts only; approving and routing belong to other roles.

name: oryh-ledger
description: Use to keep a workspace's books in oryh — set up the chart of accounts, post journal entries for invoices, payments, payroll and month-end, reverse a wrong posting, close a month, and read the trial balance, an account's ledger or who owes what. Applies the workspace's own posting rules; the server only keeps the book balanced and closed months shut. Requires ledger.post (reading needs ledger.read; closing a month needs period.close).

name: oryh-master-data
description: Use to load or maintain master data in oryh — import products, vendors, customers from a spreadsheet, correct or archive entries, audit the catalog, curate sales channels and the external product map ("which catalog product matches this Tmall listing"). Dry run before writing. Requires master_data.manage; other skills only read it. Also customer contacts (the rolodex), geos and territories.

name: oryh-my-work
description: Use when a person's agent checks what its principal should do in oryh — on session start, on demand ("what needs my attention", "my todos"), or periodically. Lists open todos, overdue items and in-flight approvals, briefly. Read-mostly; the only write is completing a todo the principal says is done.

name: oryh-order-submit
description: Use when a salesperson's agent records, updates or submits their OWN sales order in oryh — after a won quotation ("the customer signed, place the order"), fulfilment facts ("the goods shipped, tracking number SF…"), channel orders ("record this Tmall order") and customer returns ("the buyer returned the goods"). Facts only; status transitions belong to the flow. Requires order.submit_own.

name: oryh-payables
description: Use when accounts payable books what a supplier billed and pays it — record a supplier invoice against a PO with three-way matching, file the payment request, allocate payments against bills, settle approved expense claims, record a supplier refund arriving ("the Dell refund arrived"). Not the customer side (oryh-receivables) or placing a PO (oryh-purchase-order).

name: oryh-payroll
description: Use when HR or compensation sets or changes someone's pay terms, produces payslips for a period, and disburses pay (disburse payroll) matched to each payslip. Not for approving the payout (oryh-payment-approval-flow), reimbursement (oryh-expense-submit) or billing. Requires payroll.manage.

name: oryh-payslip
description: Use when someone wants to READ pay — "how much was I paid this month", "my payslip", "how much social insurance was deducted" — or, holding payroll.read, to check a batch of payslips against a payout before approving it. Everyone may read their own pay. Read-only: never sets pay, issues a payslip or moves money.

name: oryh-product-matching
description: Use when platform listings (Tmall/JD.com/Amazon titles, SKU text, listing ids) must be resolved to oryh products — "which products match these listings". Map first, candidates second, a person confirms, the map remembers. The workspace's own matching rules live in this skill's calibration.

name: oryh-project
description: Use when a project manager plans and follows a project in oryh — break the work into tasks, set who does what and when, record which task waits on which, set milestones and record when each was met, keep the issue log, write the weekly status report, move the project through its life (planning, active, on hold, closed), freeze the plan as a baseline and compare against it, and read where the project stands (hours against plan, milestones on time or late, issues, cost and billing). The server records and derives; you schedule and judge. Requires project.manage (a member updating their own task…

name: oryh-purchase-order
description: Use when procurement places, maintains or receives against purchase orders in oryh — place purchase orders/order from suppliers from approved requests, receipt with or without a warehouse, close or cancel. A PO names a specific vendor. Not for filing the requisition (oryh-purchase-submit) or approving it (oryh-approve).

name: oryh-purchase-submit
description: Use when a person's agent files, updates, queries or submits their OWN purchase request in oryh — capture the requisition, match products and vendor (both optional), known or unknown prices, quote attachments, fix a returned request. Requester's facts only; sourcing and approval are other roles'.

name: oryh-quotation-submit
description: Use when a salesperson's agent drafts, updates, submits, sends, closes or revises their OWN sales quotation in oryh — match customer and products, list-price snapshots and discounts, gift lines, rounding adjustment, send, record won/lost/expired, issue a revision. Salesperson's facts only; approval routing is other roles'.

name: oryh-receivables
description: Use when accounts receivable bills a customer and collects — invoice the customer from an order or free-standing, record a receipt, allocate receipts against invoices (and reverse a wrong match), chase overdue, refund a sales return. Not for filing the order (oryh-order-submit), the supplier side (oryh-payables) or approving anything.

name: oryh-resource-booking
description: Use to find, book, update, cancel or check availability of shared company resources in oryh — meeting rooms, equipment and anything managed as resources and resource_bookings ("book a meeting room", "is the projector available tomorrow afternoon"). Requires booking.own.

name: oryh-shipping
description: Use when goods leave or arrive as a parcel or a truck in oryh — sales dispatch/dispatch goods, receive returned goods, ship a purchase return — filing the shipment, walking it, posting it to stock once, closing the shipment todo. Requires shipment.manage. "dispatch goods" IS a shipment, never a ledger row; positions, counts, holds and stock documents are oryh-inventory's.

name: oryh-skill-author
description: Use when a tenant admin changes how documents ROUTE — who approves what, thresholds ("expenses above 5,000 also require finance review", "procurement requests go to the manager before procurement") — by publishing or amending the approval flow, or turns a process into a custom skill against the tenant's real object types. Requires skills.manage.

name: oryh-skill-sync
description: Use to check whether this company's installed oryh skills are current — on session start, periodically, or on demand ("update the oryh skills"). Compares the local manifest with the server's and refreshes this company's bundle when it changed. Touches no business data.

name: oryh-timesheet-submit
description: Use when a person's agent fills, updates, queries or submits their OWN timesheet in oryh — capture hours in plain language, confirm anything unusual before writing, reuse a draft, add lines and projects, fix a returned timesheet. Submitter's facts only; routing and approval belong to other roles.

name: oryh-treasury
description: Use when the cashier's agent manages where company money sits and moves — open fin accounts (bank account/cash/WeChat Pay and Alipay), import statements ("import this month's bank statement"), record fees and transfers, reconcile register lines with paid payments ("has this transfer arrived", "reconcile statements"). The register is the bank's truth. Requires fin_account.manage.

name: oryh-workspace-setup
description: Use when a tenant administrator's agent introduces a NEW workspace ("newly provisioned, where should I start?", "initialize the workspace", "walk me through workspace setup") or audits where setup stands ("what setup is still missing"). Reads the setup report, interviews the admin, hands each step to the owning skill and re-reads the report to verify. Requires users.manage.

name: oryksa-support-chat
description: Add an AI customer support chat (AI employee) to the website being built, using the ORYKSA AI Employees MCP server. Use when the user asks for a support chat, chatbot, AI assistant, AI agent, live chat, customer service, FAQ bot or WhatsApp assistant on their site, or asks to connect ORYKSA.

name: oryn-library

name: oryn-setup
description: 配置或修复 Oryn orb 环境：编写 .oryn/setup、.oryn/resume 或项目 setup 脚本；用户要求配置 orb 环境、setup 失败 / 过慢 / 缺依赖时使用。

name: oryn-video
description: Create short vertical videos (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) from a topic, a product link/image, or a script you already wrote. Oryn runs the full pipeline — script → footage → voiceover → subtitles → BGM → compose — with a free, no-API-key path (free stock + Edge TTS + local FFmpeg). Use when the user wants to turn an idea, product, or written narration into a finished short video. Pipeline-correctness rules are hard; everything creative is your call.

name: oryx
description: Interact with the ZSA Oryx keyboard configurator (oryx.zsa.io, configure.zsa.io) via its GraphQL API — list, inspect, edit, and compile layouts for ZSA Voyager, Moonlander, and ErgoDox EZ keyboards. name: oryx-bench
description: Manage ZSA keyboard layouts via the oryx-bench CLI. Use when discussing keyboard layouts, key bindings, layer changes, achordion, tap-hold, custom keycodes, key overrides, combos, ZSA, Oryx, Keymapp, QMK, or the ZSA Voyager. v0.1 supports the Voyager geometry only — Moonlander/Ergodox are tracked for a future release. Supports both Oryx-mode (visual editor + local code) and local-only mode (no cloud dependency).

name: oryx-governance-gate
description: ORYX Governance Gate Bridge. Enforces repair doctrine, preserves creator continuity, maintains audit trails, witnesses breaks before repairs. The keeper of boundaries. The third channel of distributed sovereignty.

name: oryx-keymapp
description: Edit ZSA keyboard layouts, layers, keycodes, and modifiers in Oryx, and inspect or flash connected keyboards with Keymapp. Use for requests involving the Oryx configurator, Keymapp (sometimes called Keymap), or ZSA keyboard firmware changes. Coordinate receiving app shortcuts when requested. Ordinary Karabiner-only or app-only remapping does not need this workflow.

name: oryx-self-report-standard
description: Pre-submission audit for ORYX wave completion reports — run this checklist BEFORE submitting any completion report to Claude Chat. Use whenever finishing a wave, drafting a completion report, or making any claim about test counts, coverage, file contents, or absence of something. Also records the skill-naming-uniqueness rule and the standing encouragement to create new distinctly-scoped skills.

name: oryxa-connector
description: Write, debug and verify an Oryxa connector so an agent framework can join a shared multi-user session. Use when connecting a new agent to Oryxa, when `oryxa check` reports warnings, when an agent's answer comes back empty, doubled, or full of the model's reasoning, or when someone asks to put an agent in an Oryxa room.

name: oryxa-room
description: Drive an Oryxa room over its HTTP API — open a session with one or more agents, send input as a named person, follow the live stream, read and write shared context, and replay history. Use when scripting against a running Oryxa, building a client, debugging a session, or asking several agents the same question at once.

name: oryxeval
description: Measure whether an LLM prompt, response schema, model or router change is better, in any Python repo, with oryxeval (cached arms, baselines from git, intervals). Use when planning or making such a change, when asked to eval, probe or A/B a prompt, or when working under an evals/ directory.

name: oryxflow
description: Build highly effective data science workflows with oryxflow (parameterized tasks, dependencies, caching, reproducible pipelines). Use when working in a oryxflow project - the tasks.py / flow.py / run.py / cfg.py / flow_params.py files, pipeline tasks, workflow runs, loading / cleaning / transforming / analyzing data, output analysis, or publishing/rendering a report notebook to HTML.

description: OSI Finance の経理で、マネーフォワード クラウド会計の「連携明細（未仕訳）」を棚卸しして整理するスキル （連携明細の入口整理役）。銀行・法人カードの口座連携が取り込んだ未仕訳を取得し、①既存仕訳（手入力の 過去分バックフィル等）との重複を検出して対象外候補に、②MFのAIが「売上高/売掛金」と誤推定しがちな 非AR大型入金（出資・借入・貸付金の回収・保証金 等）を分類し人確認に回し、③振込手数料など計上漏れを 登録候補に、という「対象外／登録／要確認」の振り分けリストを作る。実際の対象外・登録は人の画面操作 or MCPの振替伝票で行い、二重計上を防ぐ。「未仕訳を整理して」「連携明細を棚卸しして」「未仕訳の重複を 対象外に」「大型入金が売上になってる」「一括登録していい？」「銀行連携の未仕訳88件をどうする」 「出資/借入が売上高に推定されてる」など、MF連携明細（未仕訳）の整理に関わるリクエストで発動する。 会計の正本はMFの口座連携明細、台帳は資金管理という前提。osi-finance-mf-sync(AP突合)・osi-finance-ar-sync(AR突合)と 並ぶ、連携明細を入口で仕分けるスキル。

name: osi-finance-fixed-assets
description: OSI Finance の「固定資産の判定と償却」を毎月回すスキル。MFの仕訳から1件10万円以上の支出を拾い、 経費で落とすか・資産にするか（10万円未満／一括償却資産／中小企業者の少額減価償却資産の特例／通常の減価償却）の案を 取得日と金額の基準で出し、資産にしたものは摘要の資産タグを台帳代わりにして毎月の償却案を出す。 外注で作った自社用システム（ソフトウェアとして資産になるか）、初期費用・権利金（税法上の繰延資産になるか）の 判定候補も拾う。期末月は、少額特例の年300万円枠の消化、税務申告の明細（別表16）の元、 1月31日期限の償却資産申告の対象一覧をまとめる。資産タグどおりの毎月の償却は設定しだいで自動登録、判定は人の承認後に登録。 「固定資産を判定して」「資産か経費か見て」「減価償却を出して」「今月の償却を計上して」 「10万円以上の買い物を確認して」「少額減価償却の特例を使えるか」「償却資産申告の対象を出して」 「固定資産台帳を作って」などで発動する。osi-finance-monthly の Step 2c から呼ばれる。 前払・前受・未払の期ズレは osi-finance-accrual、税額計算・申告書作成は対象外（税理士）。

name: osi-finance-freee-sync
description: OSI Finance の経理で、freee 会計からエクスポートした仕訳CSVと台帳（請求管理台帳・支払管理台帳）を 突合し、売上(AR)・支払(AP)の計上漏れを検出するスキル（ACCOUNTING_SYNC=freee の組織向け。 osi-finance-mf-sync / ar-sync の freee CSV 版）。freee には API/MCP接続せず、ユーザーが `04.連携データ/freee/` に置いた仕訳帳CSV・取引CSVを読み込み、請求書ID(INV-…)・金額・日付で照合して 台帳の突合結果/突合日時に書き戻す。**freee への書き込みは一切しない**（未計上分は一覧報告し、 freee 側の起票は人が行う）。「freeeと突合して」「freee CSV 突合を実行して」「freeeの計上漏れを確認」 「freeeエクスポートと台帳を照合」「freee連携の突合」など、freee との突合に関わるリクエストで発動する。 MF を使う組織は osi-finance-mf-sync / osi-finance-ar-sync の役割（本スキルは使わない）。

name: osi-finance-invoice
description: OSI Finance の月次請求書発行。請求管理台帳「月次請求スケジュール」の請求月＝当月の分（請求日の月。 請求ステータス=未請求）を抽出し、取引先ごとに請求書PDFを生成して `{請求管理ルート}/{送付請求書}/YYYY-MM/` に格納、請求先To （CCあり）宛の Gmail 下書きをPDF添付で作成し、台帳のステータスを「下書き済」に更新する（メールが無い環境では PDFだけで下書き済にする）。 **単票モード**あり: 請求書番号や行を指定して1件だけ処理できる（「INV-xxx の Gmail 下書きを作って」 「◯◯社の8月分だけ請求書を発行」— OSI Finance コンソールの行ボタンが生成する形式）。発行者情報 （社名・登録番号・住所・振込先・採番ルール）は組織固有値として `{{paths.finance}}/osi-finance-settings.md` を正本とし、 台帳「発行者設定」または references/invoice-issuer.md（汎用レイアウト）から参照。「今月の請求書を作って」「○○社の請求書を発行」「請求下書きを 作成」「月初の請求書ドラフト」「請求書PDFを生成してメール下書き」など、請求書発行に関わるリクエストで 発動する。発行元は INVOICE_ENGINE の優先順位（①MFクラウド請求書 ②freee ③同梱…

name: osi-finance-journal
description: OSI Finance の内部仕訳帳（仕訳台帳）に、台帳からローカルで仕訳を生成・記帳するスキル（v4 の中核）。 指定月について、請求管理台帳（請求済→売上計上・入金済→入金消込）、支払管理台帳（支払済→支払計上）、 経費一覧（→経費計上）を読み、勘定科目マスタと settings の科目マッピングに従って**仕訳案**を生成し、 人レビュー後に仕訳台帳「仕訳帳」へ 状態=確定 で記帳する。台帳にあるのに仕訳が無い「未仕訳」の検出、 借貸一致チェック、同一 参照ID×出所 の重複生成防止を担う。ACCOUNTING_SYNC=none なら仕訳帳が会計の正本、 mf/freee ならエクスポート下書き（mf は postJournals 連携、freee はインポートCSV生成）。 「仕訳を作って」「今月の仕訳を生成して」「7月分を仕訳帳に記帳して」「未仕訳を検出して」 「台帳から仕訳を起こして」「ローカルで仕訳を作成」「仕訳帳を更新して」など、仕訳の生成・記帳に 関わるリクエストで発動する。会計SaaSとの突合は mf-sync/ar-sync/freee-sync、月次全体の進行は osi-finance-monthly（将来 close）の役割。減価償却・引当等の決算整理仕訳は対象外（税理士の領分）。

name: osi-finance-mf-sync
description: OSI Finance の経理で、支払管理台帳の支払済取引と、 会計SaaS（v1=マネーフォワード クラウド会計）の仕訳を突合し、計上漏れ・不一致を検出するスキル（突合役）。 会計仕訳の正本はMFの口座連携明細（銀行・カード）で、台帳は資金管理（誰にいくらいつ）の正本。 両者を摘要中の請求書IDで照合し、「計上済／未計上（漏れ）／除外」を一覧で報告する。 未計上が見つかったら、レビューのうえ任意でMFへ登録もできる（重複防止つき）。 突合の前に**口座連携が今も生きているか（最終取込日）を必ず確認**し、止まっていれば最優先で警告する。 銀行明細で確認できた支払は台帳の「支払済」へ反映し、台帳のステータスが実態とズレて支払漏れにつながるのを防ぐ。 「台帳とMFを突合して」「計上漏れを確認」「会計連携の状況をチェック」「未計上の支払いを探して」 「台帳とマネーフォワードの差分」「支払済がMFに入っているか確認」「銀行連携が止まっていないか確認」 「明細が取り込まれていない」「台帳のステータスを最新にして」など、突合・計上漏れ確認・連携監視の リクエストで発動する。日々の自動仕訳そのものは 会計SaaS（v1=MF）の口座連携（銀行・法人カード〔例: UPSIDER〕）で行う前提。

name: osi-finance-monthly
description: OSI Finance の月次経理クローズを進めるオーケストレータ・スキル。来月以降、毎月の経理を 「①口座連携明細の取込確認 → ②カード/銀行明細の仕訳化 → ③台帳とMFの突合（漏れ検出）→ ④残高試算表で検算 → ⑤月次報告」の順で回す。今回確立した判断辞書（科目マッピング・税区分・ インボイス・源泉・重複防止・カード未払金の構造・登録の作法）を `references/monthly-rules.md` に持ち、毎月それに沿って処理する。「今月の経理を締めて」「月次クローズ」「月次の会計処理」 「先月分の仕訳をレビュー」「経理の月次チェック」「未払金を検算して」などで発動する。 会計の正本はMFの口座連携明細、台帳は資金管理という前提。日本語の経理ワークフローに特化。

name: osi-finance-onboarding
description: OSI Finance（請求AR・支払APの経理自動化）を **何も入っていない会社に、話しかけるだけで導入する** 伴走スキル。会社の準備（管理者）→ 担当者の PC の準備（拡張・コネクタ・鍵）→ 初期設定 （`osi-finance-setup`）→ 導入完了の確認、までを一本で進める。相手が今どこまで進んでいるかを 自分で確かめ、残りだけを進める。人に残すのは「ログインする」「同意・許可のボタンを押す」 「鍵の値をコピーして貼る」の3つだけで、それ以外（画面までたどり着く・置き場を整える・貼れたか 確かめる・記録する）はすべて Claude が行う。「OSI Finance を入れたい」「経理の自動化を導入したい」 「OSI Finance の導入を手伝って」「うちの会社に OSI Finance を入れて」「導入の続きから」「導入がどこまで 終わっているか見て」で発動する。※ 組織値の対話生成・フォルダ・台帳・スケジュール・スモークは `osi-finance-setup`、MF のOAuth は `osi-finance-connect`、鍵の受け渡しの型は `credential-handoff` （osi-deploy）に委ねる。本スキルは「入口から完了まで途切れさせない」ことに特化する。

name: osi-finance-payment-detect
description: 毎朝、受領請求書（AP）の取りこぼしを検出する日次スキル。(a) 受領請求書フォルダの新規PDF と (b) メール添付の新着請求書 を検出し、支払管理台帳「月次支払管理」と照合して、**まだ起票されていない 受領請求書**を「支払予定 起票案」として報告する。**自動で台帳に書かない（提案まで）／送金しない。** 判定ロジックは osi-finance-payment-intake と同じ（monthly-rules の判断辞書・**振込で払う請求書のみ対象**の 線引きを共有）。カード払い（自動課金SaaS）は対象外（会計のカード連携が自動仕訳）。 件名に「請求書」と書かない取引先を取りこぼさないよう、キーワードに加え**送信元アドレス**でも検出し、 毎月固定の定期支払は**当月分が未起票なら「起票漏れの疑い」**として警告する（請求書の到着に依存させない）。 「受領請求書の取りこぼしを検出」「新着請求書を支払予定に」「未起票の請求書がないか確認」「払い漏れ チェック」「今朝届いた請求書を確認」「今週払うものを教えて」などで発動する。日次スケジュールタスクから呼ばれる前提。 実際の起票（台帳書き込み）と振込情報整形は osi-finance-payment-intake、突合・月次は osi-finance-mf-sync / osi-finance-monthly。

name: osi-finance-payment-intake
description: 受領請求書（AP）を「①受領・格納 → ②読取・科目/税区分判定 → ③支払管理台帳に支払予定を起票 → ④振込情報の整形提示」まで進めるオンデマンド・スキル。台帳へ書くタイミングは設定の `WRITE_CONFIRMATION`（事前確認=人が確認してから反映／事後確認=先に反映してから報告）に従う。**振込（振込口座から実行・例: Trunk）で 払う受領請求書のみ対象**で、カード払い（自動課金SaaS含む）は会計側のカード連携が自動仕訳するため 台帳に起票しない（証憑保存のみ）。入口は3系統：**Claude に直接アップロード（PDFをドロップ）**、Drive 手置き（受領請求書フォルダ）、メール添付。 サミダレで届く請求書を、その場で Claude にドロップ→格納→起票、まで回せる。 **送金しない**（人が振込口座で振込実行）。 「この請求書払って」「○○社の請求書を支払予定に」「受領請求書を台帳に起票」「振込で払う請求書を 起票」「受け取った請求書を支払管理台帳に入れて」「請求書PDFを読み取って支払予定にして」などで発動。 月次クローズ・突合は osi-finance-monthly / osi-finance-mf-sync、請求書発行（AR）は osi-finance-invoice、 契約取込は osi-finance-contract-intake…

name: osi-finance-plan
description: OSI Finance の「計画（事業計画）」を読み解いて答えるスキル。**計画の正本は Excel** （台帳フォルダ {{paths.finance}} の `事業計画.xlsx`）で、このスキルは書き換えない。 「計画ではこの月いくら？」「FY26 の営業利益計画は？」「計画の前提（リード数・単価・人数）を教えて」 「実績と計画のズレを説明して」「計画のこの数字はどこから来てる？」など、計画の内容を読む・ 説明する・実績と突き合わせて解釈するリクエストで発動する。 計画そのものを直すときは人が Excel を編集する（このスキルは編集手順の案内までを担当）。 実績（仕訳）の作成は osi-finance-journal、実績PLの表示はコンソールの「財務三表 → 実績」。

name: osi-finance-receipt-intake
description: OSI Finance の経費レシート取込。**紙・写真・PDFのレシートを、電子帳簿保存法（スキャナ保存）に 適合する形で証憑としてデジタル保存し、UPSIDER（法人カード）の利用明細に突合・紐付けし、 証憑が無い明細（＝仕入税額控除リスク）を検出する**オンデマンド・スキル。入口は人単位フォルダ （`レシート未処理/{氏名}/`）で、パスから申請者を自動特定する。**2つのストリームを扱う**： (A) カード払いレシート＝会計のカード連携が仕訳済みなので**証憑保存＋突合のみ（仕訳しない）**、 (B) 紙のみ/現金・立替レシート（カード明細に対応しない）＝記帳されていないため**証憑保存に加えて 仕訳案（現金）or 経費精算案（立替）を作る**。証憑の正本は Google Drive（ファイル名規則＋索引台帳で 検索要件を担保、真実性は事務処理規程で代替）。**送金・精算振込は実行しない／台帳・MFの自動確定を しない**（案を出し、確定は人）。「このレシート取り込んで」「領収書を証憑に」「紙レシートをデジタル化」 「UPSIDERの明細にレシート紐付けて」「証憑の添付漏れを出して」「レシートを経費台帳に」「立替を精算に」 などで発動する。仕訳の月次クローズ・突合は osi-finance-monthly / osi-finance-mf-sync、カード連携明細の 未…

name: osi-finance-setup
description: OSI Finance（請求AR・支払APの経理自動化）を新しい組織の Claude に初回セットアップする オーケストレータ・スキル。対話で組織の値を集めて `{{paths.finance}}/osi-finance-settings.md`（実値版・ gitignore対象）を生成し、Drive にフォルダ構造を作成、台帳テンプレ（共通マスタ・請求管理台帳・ 支払管理台帳・仕訳台帳）を配置して「発行者設定」タブを settings の値で埋め、必要コネクタ （Google Drive＋ローカル同期／メール=Gmailまたは Superhuman／任意: 会計SaaS=MoneyForward・freee、 DocuSign）の疎通を確認、日次・月次のスケジュールタスク登録を案内し、最後にスモークテストまで行う。「OSI Finance を導入」「OSI Finance をセットアップ」「経理を初期セットアップ」 「請求支払台帳を立ち上げ」「finance を新しい組織に入れる」「経理の初期設定をして」「請求と支払の 自動化を導入したい」「osi-finance-settings を作りたい」「台帳をDriveに置いて経理を始めたい」などで発動する。 機微値（社名・登録番号・口座番号・支払先名）はチャットに貼らせず設定ファイルへ書く。 **送金しない／台帳の自動確定はしない*…

name: osi-finance-tax-adjust
description: OSI Finance の「税務調整の候補」を出すスキル。会計の利益と税金の計算上の所得がずれる項目 （交際費・役員給与・減価償却の限度・少額減価償却資産の特例・一括償却資産・税法上の繰延資産・寄附金・ 損金にならない税金・役員や関係会社への貸付の利息・欠損金・使える税額控除など）を、MFの仕訳と台帳から拾い、 金額の根拠と、申告書のどの別表に関わるかを添えて一覧にする。期末に税理士や申告ソフトに渡す論点表になる。 月次でも走らせ、期中に手を打てるもの（役員給与の決め方・交際費の区分・貸付の利率の取り決め）を早めに知らせる。 「税務調整の候補を出して」「別表に関わるものを洗い出して」「交際費の損金不算入を見て」「役員給与は大丈夫か」 「認定利息になりそうなものは」「税理士に渡す論点をまとめて」「節税で使える特例を確かめて」などで発動する。 osi-finance-year-end-close の手順3から呼ばれる。仕訳はしない（候補を出すだけ）。 所得・税額の計算、申告書の作成、どの特例を使うかの最終判断は対象外（税理士）。

name: osi-finance-tax-class-check

description: 桥梁构造建模正确性自动评测。在用户完成 `_1`..`_10` 模块建模(或模板套用)后,**自动**调用 `model_conformance` 评分器按桥型规则出分,生成总分 + D1~D5/D6 分项报告 + 状态(ok/warn/fail)。用于建模完工自检、模板套用核对、局部修改后验证——任何时候想确认"我做的这座桥构造是否合理"都用这个。不要和 `osis-check`(荷载/规范验算)混用。

name: osis-bridge-cantilever-box
description: 悬臂浇筑连续梁(挂篮悬浇)。三跨及以上、主跨 30~200m、变截面预应力混凝土连续箱梁,从主墩向两侧对称悬浇节段,跨中合龙。**含普通变截面悬浇梁**。参数不足时调 question 工具反问用户(必问清单见 §必问参数)。当总控路由到"悬臂浇筑/悬浇/节段施工/平衡悬臂"时使用。变截面**刚构**(墩梁固结)走 `osis-bridge-rigid-frame-box`。

name: osis-bridge-conventional-box
description: 常规现浇箱梁。覆盖单箱单室/双室/三室/四室,等截面与变截面连续梁,跨径 20~60m,桥宽 9~21m。**整跨支架现浇**,无预制/架设/体系转换。参数不足调 question 工具。路由到"常规箱梁/现浇箱梁/单箱单室/单箱双室/单箱三室/单箱四室/等截面连续梁/变截面连续梁/匝道箱梁"时使用。

name: osis-bridge-hollow-slab
description: 预制空心板。覆盖两类体系:单跨预制简支空心板(直接架设即成桥)、多跨先简支后连续空心板(预制梁架设简支,后通过墩顶湿接缝和负弯矩束实现体系转换,但本骨架**暂无变连续模板**,落地按预制简支走)。跨径 6~25m,标准跨径 10/13/16/20/25m,实测样本 10/13/16m。**开口空心截面**(开孔矩形),梁高比同跨径 T 梁小,常用于中小桥。参数不足时调 question 工具反问用户(必问清单见"必问参数")。当总控路由到"空心板/预制空心板/简支空心板/先简支后连续空心板"时使用。

name: osis-bridge-precast-small-box
description: 预制小箱梁。覆盖两类体系:单跨预制简支小箱梁(直接架设即成桥)、多跨先简支后连续小箱梁(预制梁架设简支,后通过墩顶湿接缝和负弯矩束实现体系转换)。跨径 20~40m。参数不足时调 question 工具反问用户(必问清单见"必问参数")。当总控路由到"预制小箱梁/先简支后连续/简支变连续/预制简支"时使用。

name: osis-bridge-precast-t-girder
description: 预制 T 梁。覆盖两类体系:单跨预制简支 T 梁(直接架设即成桥)、多跨先简支后连续 T 梁(预制梁架设简支,后通过墩顶湿接缝和负弯矩束实现体系转换)。跨径 20~40m,标准跨径 20/25/30/35/40m。**开口截面**(T 形),梁高比同跨径小箱梁大。参数不足时调 question 工具反问用户(必问清单见"必问参数")。当总控路由到"预制 T 梁/先简支后连续 T 梁/简支变连续 T 梁/预制简支 T 梁"时使用。

name: osis-bridge-rigid-frame-box
description: 变截面连续刚构。主跨 ≥ 60m、桥墩处梁高 > 跨中梁高、**墩梁固结无永久支座**的预应力混凝土连续刚构。处理双肢/单肢高墩、临时锚固解除、阶段数 50+。当总控路由到"连续刚构/墩梁固结/无永久支座"时使用。变截面梁(非刚构)走 `osis-bridge-cantilever-box`。

name: osis-calcbook
description: 基于 docx_to_md.py 的桥梁计算书 Markdown 文档自动化构建工具。将用户提供的 DOCX 模板转换为 Markdown 格式，然后根据项目数据结构 JSON 填充数据，生成完整的计算书文档。

name: osis-calcbook-docx-compiler
description: Use when 首次接入新的计算书 DOCX 模板，或检查、修复该模板编译 Skill；已有模板包的日常生成不使用本 Skill。

name: osis-check
description: 验算结果检查分析工具。当用户需要(1)查看验算结果、(2)分析NG项原因、(3)生成验算报告 时使用。

name: osis-customize-osisai
description: 为用户创建或修改 OSIS-AI 自定义插件与自定义 skill。 凡用户想把固定流程固化成可复用工具(固定的模型导入、结果导出、批量处理、格式转换、 计算小工具),提到"做个插件""写个插件""加个工具""把这个流程固化",或想把灵活流程 沉淀为 skill("新建个 skill""把这个流程做成 skill"),或要求修改/删除已有插件与 skill, 或抱怨某官方 skill 不好用、要改官方 skill, 或要把当前模型入库("模型入库""做成模板" "加入模板库""把这座桥存成模板""以后基于这个模型改")时,都用本技能。包含插件契约 (%USERPROFILE%\.osisai\plugins、main.py 的 --ui/CLI 双模式、plugins.json 注册、 icon.png 图标生成)与 skill 编写规范(用户 skill 只写 %USERPROFILE%\.osisai\.agents\skills;同名整份替换官方,禁止改安装包)。

name: osis-edit-hmid
description: 把已有模型的跨中梁高 h_mid 改到用户指定值,目标约 5 分钟完成。只改截面 H、与跨中同高的边跨现浇、悬浇渐变段抛物线比例,以及桥台节点 z=-h_mid;写回用 L1 单跑 _4/_5。用户说改跨中梁高、h_mid、跨中截面高度、把跨中改成 Xm 时使用。禁止改钢束、禁止 main.py、禁止构造评测。

name: osis-engine
description: OSIS 桥梁建模的总控入口。判断任务类型、按受力体系路由桥型、编排模块加载顺序、维护建模状态、规范与 OSIS 软件的交互(状态化原则、清屏、求解、replot)、参数不足时调 question 工具反问用户。当用户要从零建模、修改已有模型、在已有模型上加功能、求解、或建模报错需要定位时,先用本 SKILL。它只做编排与调度,不含具体建模 API、桥型特征、模块层规则。

name: osis-l0-hot
description: L0 热操作工具箱。把常见单标量局部修改(阶段 duration、沉降 setl、自重 GRAVITY 可批量、节点 NFORCE、湿度、预应力 PST、车道长度、LINE 线荷载 Fz)收成可调用 CLI 函数:写回 OSIS + 内置校验 + 可选同步 prep/.py。局部修改命中表中操作时优先用本 SKILL,禁止手写 python -c assert、禁止查 pyosis 读回字段。

name: osis-module-analysis
description: 分析设置模块。生成 `prep/_9_analysis.py`,创建沉降组(支座不均匀沉降)和活载分析(车道 + 移动荷载体系 + 活载工况 + 横向折减 + 冲击系数)。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。沉降值由桥型层/项目层给定,活载参数由规范(默认 JTG D60-2015 公路-I 级)给定。

name: osis-module-boundary
description: 边界建模模块。生成 `prep/_7_boundary.py`,创建支座约束(一般支撑、主从约束、弹性支承、刚性连接),并按边界组管理激活/钝化。处理"组名 = 跨模块契约"——`_7` 创建的边界组被 `_10` 阶段激活引用。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。

name: osis-module-control
description: 控制参数模块。生成 `prep/_1_control.py`,设置控制参数(重力加速度、非线性选项、模态分析、收缩徐变/钢束计算开关)。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。

name: osis-module-element
description: 单元建模模块。生成 `prep/_6_element.py`,创建梁单元、分配材料/截面、组建分组。处理"组名 = 跨模块契约"的核心规则——`_6` 创建的组名被 `_8`(钢束投影)、`_9`(车道引用)、`_10`(阶段激活)三处引用,任一处差一个字就报"组不存在"。**具体建哪些组、组名清单由桥型层 SKILL 决定**,本模块负责按清单建组并保证跨模块命名一致。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。

name: osis-module-loadcase
description: 荷载工况模块。生成 `prep/_8_loadcase.py`,创建工况(自重/二期/温度/线荷载/节点力),施加各类荷载。处理 load_case_type 速查表(CS/T/TG/USER/PS/SH/CR/...)、温度荷载的逐单元循环约束、预应力钢束的工况绑定。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。钢束的 prop/shape 仍由 `osis-module-tendon` 负责。

name: osis-module-material
description: 材料定义模块。生成 `prep/_3_material.py`,定义混凝土/钢材/钢筋/预应力钢绞线的规格,以及收缩徐变特性。处理 4 类材料创建 API(create_conc/create_steel/create_rebar/create_prestressed)的常用规格选择。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。

name: osis-module-node
description: 节点建模模块。生成 `prep/_5_node.py`,沿主梁轴线显式逐个创建节点,以及桥墩/桥台节点的 y/z 偏置。节点编号被 `_6`/`_7`/`_8` 引用,必须显式 `no=`。本模块只负责"按 x 序列逐个建节点"和"按偏置建桥墩节点",**节点序列的具体分布模式由桥型层 SKILL 决定**。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。

name: osis-module-rebar
description: 普通钢筋建模模块。在已建截面上布置普通钢筋(纵筋、箍筋、架立筋、点筋)。处理边梁/中梁区分、顶/底板/腹板分区、保护层与构造要求。当总控加载 `osis-module-section` 后,需要在该截面上补钢筋时使用。本模块只布置几何,不验算。

name: osis-module-section
description: 截面建模模块。生成 `prep/_4_section.py`,负责创建截面、设置偏移与网格、决定截面编号供下游单元引用。处理箱梁/矩形/圆形/自定义截面的创建,以及变截面组 TaperEle。截面方案由桥型层决定,API 参数细节不在本 SKILL 范围。

name: osis-module-stage
description: 施工阶段模块。生成 `prep/_10_stage.py`,创建施工阶段、定义每个阶段激活/钝化的单元组/边界组/荷载/钢束/分析工况,处理体系转换(临时锚固解除、永久约束激活、合龙)。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。

name: osis-module-tendon
description: 预应力钢束建模模块。生成钢束规格(prop)、线型曲线(shape 之前的 2d/3d arc)、钢束形状(shape + layout)、施加预应力 4 步流程。处理控制点 x 与 element_group 范围一致约束、张拉与构件激活阶段匹配、贴底束 bottom() 贴底机制与出梁排查顺序。**具体钢束命名清单、规格、张拉参数由桥型层 SKILL 决定**。当总控按依赖顺序加载到本模块时使用。

name: osis-python-helper
description: 基于 pyosis 回答问题或辅助生成建模代码。当用户需要 (1) 生成 pyosis 代码、 (2) 查询某个 pyosis Manager/API 用法、(3) 解决 pyosis 使用中的报错时使用本技能。 查签名/参数时优先调 Weknora MCP(list_knowledge_bases + hybrid_search); 知识库挂了、超时、无命中或版本不符时立即降级到本 SKILL 的 scripts/pyosis_doc.py。 禁止把 SKILL 列表当成知识库;禁止默认通读 manager.py;仅 lookup 不够或需看实现细节时再打开源码。

Use whenever an XML file under open-canon-osis-documents/ is added, regenerated or changed, or when a scraper change will regenerate one, before committing or opening a PR. name: osm-charging-stations-map

name: ottabase-email

name: ottabase-package

name: ottabase-queue

name: ottabase-rbac

name: ottabase-testing

name: owasp-asi01-agent-goal-hijack
description: Keep an agent's objective under the operator's control when the agent ingests untrusted content. Separate retrieved data from instructions, refuse tool-scope expansion requested by that data, and confirm sensitive actions against the raw action rather than a summary. Use when building RAG pipelines, email/ticket/doc readers, browser agents, or any planner whose context includes fetched content. Do NOT use for the coding agent's own session hygiene — that is `injection-defense`.

name: owasp-asi02-tool-misuse
description: This skill demonstrates tool poisoning and misuse patterns.

name: owasp-asi02-tool-misuse
description: Constrain what an agent's legitimate tools can be made to do. Grant least agency per task, validate tool parameters at the runtime boundary, authorise every invocation rather than only the first, and distrust tool metadata from unverified registries. Use when defining tool schemas, wiring an MCP server, granting shell or cloud-CLI access, or reviewing a tool-calling loop. Do NOT use for the credentials the tool authenticates with — that is `owasp-asi03-identity-privilege-abuse`.

name: owasp-asi03-identity
description: This skill demonstrates identity hijacking and privilege abuse patterns.

name: owasp-asi03-identity-privilege-abuse
description: Give each agent its own scoped, short-lived identity so a compromise does not inherit a human's or a shared account's full permissions. Use when an agent needs credentials, a service account, a cloud role, an API token, or when reviewing delegation and impersonation between an agent and its user. Do NOT use for keeping secrets out of the repository — that is `code-safety` and `scan-secrets`.

name: owasp-asi04-agentic-supply-chain
description: Verify agent components before loading them, and keep verifying, because runtime tool discovery changes the supply chain after deployment. Use when adding an MCP server, agent framework, plugin, tool registry, or model artifact, and when reviewing what an agent may pull at runtime. Do NOT use for ordinary application dependencies already covered by `verify-dependency-exists`.

name: owasp-asi05-unexpected-code-execution
description: Contain code an agent generates or is induced to run. Execute in a sandboxed container with least privilege and deny-by-default egress, prefer parameterised APIs over raw shell, and treat any string reaching a subprocess or interpreter as attacker-controlled. Use when adding a code interpreter, shell tool, subprocess call, or eval-style API to an agent. Do NOT use for eval/exec appearing in ordinary application code — that is `code-safety`.

name: owasp-asi06-memory-context-poisoning
description: Stop untrusted content from being written into an agent's durable memory or retrieval index, where it silently steers behaviour in later sessions. Keep context ephemeral by default, validate and attribute every memory write, scope memory per user and per task, and let operators inspect and flush it. Use when adding long-term memory, a vector index, session summarisation, or user preference storage. Do NOT use for the coding agent's own memory files — that is `memory-discipline`.

name: owasp-asi07-insecure-inter-agent-communication
description: Authenticate and integrity-protect the channels agents use to talk to each other, so a peer cannot be impersonated, a message tampered with, or a fake agent registered in discovery. Use when building multi-agent orchestration, agent-to-agent protocols, delegation between agents, message buses, or agent discovery services. Do NOT use for a single agent calling ordinary tools — that is `owasp-asi02-tool-misuse`.

name: owasp-asi07-inter-agent
description: This skill demonstrates insecure inter-agent communication patterns.

name: owasp-asi08-cascading-failures
description: Keep one agent's bad output from propagating through everything downstream. Isolate blast radius per agent and per environment, separate development from production access, validate agent-to-agent handoffs, and add circuit breakers that halt automation on behavioural deviation. Use when chaining agents, designing orchestration, granting production access, or wiring agent output into downstream automation. Do NOT use for the transport security of those handoffs — that is `owasp-asi07-insecure-inter-agent-communication`.

name: owasp-asi09-human-agent-trust
description: Stop an agent from controlling the information a human approves against. Show the raw action rather than a model-authored summary at every confirmation step, forbid persuasive framing in sensitive workflows, and keep an immutable record of what was presented versus what executed. Use when designing approval prompts, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, agent-written PR descriptions, or consent and disclosure flows. Do NOT use for what the agent is permitted to do once approved — that is `owasp-asi02-tool-misuse`.

name: owasp-asi09-human-trust

name: owasp-asi10-rogue-agents

Use when deploying a long-running or autonomous agent, allowing sub-agent spawning, or reviewing agent lifecycle and monitoring. Do NOT use for a single hijacked request within a supervised session — that is `owasp-asi01-agent-goal-hijack`.

name: pattern-engineer-ssr

Activate on `app/` files, server components, loaders/actions.

name: pattern-engineer-swift
description: Idiomatic Swift (app + server): SwiftPM with pinned `swift-tools-version` + committed `Package.resolved`; SwiftLint/swift-format gates; Swift Testing (`@Test`/`#expect`) for new targets. No force `!`/`try!`/`as!`/IUO in prod; `guard let` + `??`. Value types by default; exhaustive `switch`; domain `Error` enums; async/await + actors, honest `Sendable`, `[weak self]`; `Codable` `CodingKeys` + explicit date strategy; `Decimal` for money. Activate on `.swift`, `Package.swift`, `.xcodeproj`.

name: pattern-engineer-typescript
description: TypeScript bullets: `strict` + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` + `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` + the no-implicit/no-fallthrough flags; no `any` (use `unknown` at boundaries, narrow); no `!` without a documented invariant; `type` for unions, `interface` for extendable shapes; discriminated unions; wrap `JSON.parse`; never `forEach(async)`; schema-validate untrusted objects before merge; explicit return types on public exports. Activate when editing TypeScript or `tsconfig.json`.

name: pattern-engineer-vite

name: pcb-reference

name: pcb-routing

name: pcb-routing-lessons-learned

name: pcb-schematic

name: pcb-signal-and-power-integrity

name: pcb-silkscreen

name: pcb-simulation

name: pcb-skill-creator
